## WebhookQueue.close() method

Close the queue and release all waiting consumers and producers.

**Signature:**

```typescript
close(): void;
```
**Returns:**

void

## Remarks

Workers waiting on `dequeue()` resolve with `undefined` (sentinel). Enqueueing after close throws.
